description: Copy some of a notebook’s sources into another existing notebook. RPC-backed. Returns, for each source, its original id and the id of the copy. The target must be named explicitly. Only from a notebook you own (not one shared with you or public). Not idempotent: a failure is never retried automatically.

source_ids.description: Ids of the sources to copy (from list_sources).

target_notebook_id.description: UUID of the notebook to copy into. Required (or target_notebook_url).

target_notebook_url.description: URL of the notebook to copy into (alternative to target_notebook_id).

name: source_copy

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
